metadata.note: Kishacoquillas Valley Railroad (KV, 'the Ol' Hook & Eye'), Mifflin County, Pennsylvania: a locally financed 9.3-mile steam short line from Belleville down the Kishacoquillas ('Big') Valley to the PRR Milroy Branch at Reedsville, opened 1893 and controlled throughout by Belleville physician Dr. John P. Getter. From 1928 its trains ran on over the PRR Milroy Branch to the PRR main line at Lewistown. Last passenger run 16 Feb 1940; abandoned and scrapped 1940. Research report: research/branches/kishacoquillas_valley_railroad.txt.
sources: John G. Hartzler, The Ol' Hook and Eye: A History of the Kishacoquillas Valley Railroad (1988; 2nd ed. 2008) - NOT SEEN

The PRR Milroy Branch is tagged old_railway_operator=PRR with note:old_railway_operator="Schuylkill and Juniata".

metadata.operator_split: None. The KV operated its own trains throughout and was never leased to or operated by the PRR. The 1928-1940 Reedsville - Lewistown run is KV trains on PRR track (trackage rights), drawn as a separate feature only so that it does not claim 1893-1927, when PRR trains ran there.
omitted: PRR Milroy Branch Lewistown - Reedsville - Milroy, PRR passenger to 1927/28: a PRR line, out of scope for this layer; flagged to the PRR queue.
Allensville: no evidence the KV ever reached it; nothing drawn west of Belleville.
The 0.3 mi reversing move KV Junction - Reedsville station for 1893-1927 (drawing it would double the line back on itself).
metadata.existing_layer_note: No existing layer for the KV or the PRR Milroy Branch was found in data/ before this layer was written.
metadata.freight_only_audit: Nothing to remove: no freight-only KV branch is documented; any freight after the 16 Feb 1940 last passenger run is not drawn.
metadata.horsecar_audit: Nothing to remove: steam from opening.
not_yet_sourced: Opening day in 1893 not found (year from JB and KVNET, both resting on Hartzler; Hartzler's book not seen).

Start of the Reedsville - Lewistown through service: JB and KVNET say 1928; the PRR's own last Lewistown - Milroy train is bracketed 9/25/1927 - 10/28/1928 (PRRTHS), so a 1927 KV start is possible but unproven. Drawn from 1928.

End: passenger last run 16 Feb 1940 (PRRTHS, asterisked 'believed correct', not a reproduced notice). Company end conflict: JB 'abandoned and sold for scrap ... in 1940' vs JB-REED 'The KVRR ceased operations in 1941'; PRR retired its KV connections 1940. Does not move the drawn passenger span.

Reedsville - Lewistown mileage: 6.5 (Fowler, to Lewistown (2nd) on the main line) vs 'seven' (KVNET) vs 5.4 to the 'Lewistown passenger station' (JB-REED, PRR figure). Trace to the main-line station measures 6.3 mi.
Frequency: no timetable seen; every headway_min and avg_speed_kmh in this layer is an estimate.
Whether passenger trains ran every year 1893-1940 without a gap (e.g. after the 1925 tornado in JB's roster note) is not established.
Whether the drawn Lewistown approach (present Juniata Valley Railroad track) is the 1928-1940 Water Street alignment.

properties.speed_source: estimated: no timetable running time was seen (the 1938 KV public timetable is cited by Fowler but its contents were not available). A 9-mile steam short line that famously 'stopped once at every single house' (Locobase quoting kvrr.net) - 20 km/h is a guess, unsourced.

properties.geometry_quality: Real-traced throughout, no straight-line legs: 9.2 mi traced (9.18) against 9.3 mi documented Belleville - Kishacoquillas Valley Junction (Fowler; W2K 9.3; JB track-list MP 9.4 to Reedsville; KVNET 'nine miles'). Every traced mile is on ways tagged old_railway_operator="Kishacoquillas Valley Railroad"; all waypoints lie on the line (0.0 km). The west end is the west end of OSM way 170404823 (40.6045, -77.7258), about 0.2 mi NE of the Belleville village point; the KV Belleville station site was not separately pinned. Way 170404823 (Belleville - Union Mills, about 1.95 mi) carries an OSM fixme 'rough alignment', so that stretch is a mapper's approximation of the grade rather than a precise trace. The east end is the KV's junction with the PRR Milroy Branch (40.6582, -77.5947). Trains then REVERSED about 0.3 mi north up the Milroy Branch into the PRR Reedsville station (Fowler: 'reverse back to KVJn'); that back-up move is NOT drawn here, because drawing it would double the line back on itself - the 1928-1940 Reedsville - Lewistown feature does cover that stretch. The 1893 alignment is not known to have been altered, so no later-alignment issue is expected.

segments.note: Train service began 1893 (year only - JB: 'Train service commenced in 1893'; KVNET: 'For 47 years (1893-1940)'; combine No. 1 on the roster from 1893, JB). Construction began 1892 after the second charter; no source puts trains in service in 1892, and the opening day is not known. Steam throughout (4-4-0 No. 1 'Belleville'), combine-hauled mixed-style trains, coaches later; a Fairbanks-Morse canopy-top railcar ran Sunday trips 1911-1918 and a home-built Studebaker railcar replaced the daily midday train 1938-1940 (JB). Fowler's stations (Cold Water, Union Mills, Gibboney, Inwood, Kishacoquillas, Taylor, Hooley, Lumber City, KV Junction, Reedsville) carry his 1938 KV public-timetable letter. From 1928 the same trains ran on through to Lewistown (separate feature). Last passenger run Lewistown - Belleville 16 Feb 1940 (PRRTHS discontinuance list, asterisked 'believed correct'); the road was abandoned and sold for scrap the same year (JB; JB-REED says 'ceased operations in 1941' - conflict, see metadata.not_yet_sourced). Any freight working after 16 Feb 1940 is not drawn (Rule 1). End year 1940 is the year of the last run, as elsewhere in data/. Headway is an ESTIMATE: no frequency was found; a 'midday train' in 1938 implies at least three workings a day.

properties.geometry_quality: Real-traced throughout, no straight-line legs: 6.3 mi traced (6.34) against 6.5 mi documented Reedsville - Lewistown (2nd) on the PRR main line (Fowler 9.6 -> 16.1); KVNET 'seven miles'; JB-REED gives 5.4 mi from Reedsville to the 'Lewistown passenger station' (PRR figure) - the trace to the main-line station supports Fowler's 6.5. 6.0 mi is on Milroy Branch ways (old_railway_operator=PRR, note:old_railway_operator=Schuylkill and Juniata) and about 0.3 mi on untagged rail at the Lewistown end. The line starts at the PRR Reedsville station (W2K 40.661863, -77.594635) and ends on the main line 0.2 km from the present Lewistown (Amtrak, ex-PRR) station point. LATER ALIGNMENT, possibly: south of Yeagertown this follows the track the Juniata Valley Railroad operates today; a JB photo shows KV trains on Water Street in Lewistown, and whether today's track through Lewistown is the same 1928-1940 street alignment, and whether the Lewistown street stops (Walnut, Chestnut, Main St) lie on it, was not checked. A router spur onto an industrial siding at Burnham was removed by trim_reversals.

segments.note: Kishacoquillas Valley trains running through from Belleville over the PRR Milroy Branch by trackage rights - PRR track, KV trains, so KV colour (no Rule 4 split). JB: 'In 1928, the KV assumed responsibility to operate passenger service between Reedsville and Lewistown on the PRR Milroy Branch'; KVNET: 'For the last 12 of those years, KV passenger service extended an additional seven miles ... to the Pennsylvania main line at Lewistown Junction'. PRRTHS brackets the PRR's own last Lewistown - Milroy train between 25 Sep 1927 and 28 Oct 1928, so a 1927 KV start is possible but unproven - drawn from 1928. Fowler's 1938 KV timetable letter appears at Yeagertown, Burnham and the Lewistown street stops. Last run Lewistown - Belleville 16 Feb 1940 (PRRTHS, 'believed correct'); PRR retired its connections to the KV in 1940 (JB-REED). Before 1928 PRR, not KV, trains ran this stretch - not drawn here (no PRR Milroy Branch layer exists yet). Headway is an ESTIMATE, as for Belleville - Reedsville.
